name: Essence Fastening Systems (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: Essence Fastening Systems (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of high-strength, high-precision fasteners and custom-engineered components. Its extensive product range primarily supports the automotive industry, supplying critical parts for various applications such as engine turbocharging systems, shift parking control mechanisms, automotive lighting, seating, interior and exterior trim, exhaust systems, and chassis assemblies, including specialized items like self-tapping self-locking screws, alongside a variety of plastic functional parts. Beyond its core automotive clientele, Essence Fastening Systems also provides its fastening solutions to sectors including electronics, telecommunications, and household appliances. The company was established in 2001 and operates from its headquarters in Shanghai, China.
